config.language: Interface language of Embedded Studio. "auto" follows the VS Code display language (Turkish if it is Turkish, otherwise English).
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
command.run: Run (build, download and run without debugger)
config.flashConfirm: Ask for confirmation before flashing (status bar Flash/Run, designer Flash).
config.probeAutoDetect: Detect probes (ST-Link, J-Link, CMSIS-DAP, DFU, UART bridges) when they are plugged in and query the connected board automatically.
config.flashTool: Tool used for flashing. "auto": OpenOCD for SWD probes, STM32CubeProgrammer for USB DFU and UART bootloader.
config.flashTool.auto: OpenOCD for SWD probes, STM32CubeProgrammer for DFU/UART
config.flashErase.sector: Only the sectors/pages that are written
config.flashVerify: Verify the flash contents after writing.
config.flashUnderReset: Connect under reset (hold NRST while connecting). Needed when the firmware puts the MCU to sleep or reuses the SWD pins.
config.flashSpeed: SWD clock in kHz (0: tool default). Lower it for long wires or unstable connections.
config.debugServer: GDB server used by Debug (F5). "auto": OpenOCD (works with ST-Link, J-Link and CMSIS-DAP).
